sections.markdown:
## C — Vehicle failures, collision avoidance and skid control

FACT_ID: sec14-F01 | anchor: A01
Follow the maintenance timetable in the vehicle’s manual to reduce mechanical-failure risk. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F02 | anchor: A01
For brakes that stop working, the manual first instructs repeated pedal pumping, which may restore enough pressure to stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F03 | anchor: A01
If pumping failed brakes does not help, the source next calls for gradual use of the parking-brake handle to avoid rear-wheel lock and a skid. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F04 | anchor: A01
If the parking-brake attempt starts a skid, be prepared to release it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F05 | anchor: A01
If those brake-failure measures fail, the manual next directs downshifting and finding a safe place to slow and stop off the roadway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F06 | anchor: A01
Do not continue driving a vehicle that has no working brakes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F07 | anchor: A01
For a sudden tire deflation, grip the wheel firmly and maintain a straight course. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F08 | anchor: A01
The blowout procedure calls for gradual slowing by releasing the accelerator and braking lightly. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F09 | anchor: A01
After a blowout, avoid stopping in the roadway if possible and move to a safe place off the road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F10 | anchor: A01
If the engine stops while driving, hold the wheel firmly; the manual warns that steering may become difficult though still possible. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F11 | anchor: A01
The engine-failure procedure calls for leaving the roadway; it says braking remains possible but may require much greater pedal pressure. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F12 | anchor: A01
If the headlights suddenly fail, the manual first suggests trying the light switch several times. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F13 | anchor: A01
If the headlight switch does not restore lighting, try the emergency flashers, turn signals or available fog lamps. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F14 | anchor: A01
With failed headlights, leave the roadway as soon as possible. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F15 | anchor: A01
For a sticking accelerator that makes the engine speed rise, keep looking at the road and promptly select neutral. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F16 | anchor: A02
After selecting neutral for a sticking accelerator, pull off the road when safe, then stop the engine [A02] [A01].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0035]

Misconceptions: pumping failed brakes and emergency braking with working ABS are separate source procedures; engine shutdown in the sticking-pedal sequence follows pulling off safely.
Mnemonics: identify the failure, keep control, follow its sequence, and reach a safe stopping place.
Glossary: ABS means antilock braking system; neutral disconnects driving power; a blowout is sudden tire deflation.
Dynamic facts: installed braking/steering systems, parking-brake design and manufacturer emergency procedures require vehicle-specific checking.

verification_debt.claim_text: Page34 mechanical procedures are source-as-written and require current manufacturer/issuer safety review. Pumping failed brakes is not instruction to pump during working-ABS quick stops. Mechanical parking-brake handles, power assistance, transmissions and electronic systems differ; no universal vehicle-performance guarantee is inferred.
